Garantir as projeções de longo prazo (Business Plan), refletindo todas as informações internas e externas que possam afetar a percepção de valor da Companhia, através da criação de cenários de negócio, através da pesquisa mercado, através da interação com áreas técnicas e agentes externos (sócios, brokers, consultores, etc), consolidando em um trabalho de modelagem financeira e materiais de apoio para disseminação junto à diretoria executiva; Elaborar análises integradas e executivas disponibilizadas à gerência executiva e diretores, consolidando os produtos das frentes técnicas, articulando as conclusões em recomendação única e preparando os materiais de submissão a fóruns e à liderança; Manter atualizado o pipeline de novos projetos estratégicos, bem como o report junto à Diretoria e eventualmente os sócios, através do preparo de apresentações que irão envolver, além a exposição do material à Diretoria e eventualmente aos sócios da Companhia; Apoiar nos esforços para execução de potenciais M& As, através da preparação de materiais especializados para exposição à Diretoria e Sócios, apoio em eventuais due diligence e interação com advogados / auditores externos relacionado à preparação e avaliação de documentos da transação; Apoiar a fomentação das discussões da área de Planejamento Estratégico, através de modelagem financeira especializada, de interações com consultores internos e externos e apoio na preparação de materiais específicos, bem como sua exposição para agentes internos e externos; Elaborar Relatórios gerenciais periódicos produzidos com informação analítica relevante, consolidando dados de desempenho, elaborando as análises de resultado e valor e produzindo os materiais de acompanhamento destinados à liderança; Apoiar a análise de cenário setorial e movimentos de mercado incorporados às análises, acompanhando fontes setoriais, indicadores de mercado e movimentos de concorrentes; traduzindo esse cenário em premissas e implicações econômicas; Elaborar cenários e análises de sensibilidade disponíveis para suporte à decisão referentes às projeções de longo prazo, estruturando cenários alternativos de mercado, utilização de frota e preço; quantificando impactos sobre resultado, caixa e indicadores financeiros; Produzir projeções reconciliadas com o desempenho realizado e com os ciclos corporativos, comparando projeções e realizado, analisando causas de desvio e assegurando aderência entre o plano de longo prazo e os processos corporativos de orçamento; title: Product designer
description:
Who We Are

We believe in a world where research never sleeps. 

Most companies struggle to understand their customers. Not because they don't try, but because market research can be siloed, slow, and incomplete.

Discuss is changing that. 

Our mission is to elevate human understanding at scale by building the always-on solution that transforms market research, making it continuous and intelligent while keeping humans at the center. We’ve built a comprehensive, innovative, set of AI-driven solutions that have made us only one of two companies named a Leader in the Forrester Wave Q1 2026 Experience Research Platforms Report. Discuss has earned top rankings by G2 for Best Results, Customer Relationships, Usability, and more for 14 consecutive quarters. We’re not slowing down any time soon. 

In the age of AI, scaling empathy without losing human understanding matters. Solving this problem makes what we do every day both interesting and rewarding. Our team believes in doing the right thing, even when it's inconvenient. We build tools that customers love because we listen to them. We believe in transparency and we own the results together. 

Discuss is a team of 200+ employees in 23 countries, serving 900 customers worldwide. We hire people who care about the humans on the other side of the data and want to help build something that hasn't existed before.

If you want your work to make the distance between organizations and the people they serve feel, for once, like it isn't there, we'd love to talk.

About this role

We're rebuilding how design happens at Discuss: an AI-assisted, code-native process where prototypes are real running code, feedback happens on live URLs instead of static frames, and a shared component system keeps design and engineering from drifting apart.

We're looking for an AI Forward Product Designer who's excited to work this way, someone comfortable moving fast with AI tools while keeping a high bar for craft, structure, and accessibility.

You'll own design work end to end across the pipeline: framing the problem, wireframing the flows, generating high-fidelity prototypes as code, running feedback on live previews, and closing the loop into our component library.

How this role works You'll own solutions in your own area of the product, working closely with a product manager and engineers, and may float between teams as coverage is needed. You'll collaborate weekly with the design director and the other design ICs for team alignment and growth.

What you'll do Take features from problem to prototype. Help frame the problem and write lightweight specs, then move into wireframes and high-fidelity work. Generate high-fidelity, interactive prototypes as real code (React, shadcn, Tailwind) using AI tools like Claude Code/Design, working against our shared design tokens and components. Wireframe in low fidelity first, focusing on structure and flow before visual polish, covering every real state and not just the happy path. Run feedback on live prototypes hosted on Vercel. Gather comments, triage them, and fold decisions back into the work and the spec. Keep the design system honest. Contribute components and tokens back to our shared shadcn registry and its hosted component reference (Storybook), so what's designed matches what ships. Work in the open, in version control. Your specs, flows, wireframes, and prototypes live as files in the repo, reviewed like code. Design with light and dark mode and accessibility built in from the start, not bolted on.

What we're looking for Around 4 years of product design experience. Strong product design fundamentals: interaction design, layout, information hierarchy, and a good eye for visual craft. Strong taste and design judgment. You can tell what's working and what isn't, edit toward the better version, and raise the quality bar without needing every decision spelled out. Comfort with AI-assisted design tools and a willingness to work in a convention-driven way, where shared rules guide and review the work. Enough technical fluency to work in code-based prototypes. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable reading and adjusting React and Tailwind, and working in a repo (Git, pull requests, markdown). Experience with component-based design systems and design tokens. Solid grasp of accessibility (WCAG basics, keyboard nav, contrast, semantics). Clear communication with product and engineering. You can write a tight spec and explain a design decision.

Nice to have Experience running or designing for usability tests. Familiarity with Figma as a fine-tuning and handoff tool (we use it selectively, not as our source of truth). Experience with Storybook, or documenting a design system for other teams to build against. Exposure to MCP-based or other shared-system tooling across multiple products or teams. Experience designing for B2 B or B2 B2 C Saa S products.

How is success measured in this role Speed from wireframe approved to stakeholder sign-off. You help shrink that gap. Handoff fidelity. The work you promote into the component library holds up against production code without heavy rework. Quality of feedback. Prototypes are real and clickable enough that stakeholders react precisely, early, and often. Product outcomes. Work you ship moves adoption metrics (via Pendo) in the intended direction, and usability issues don't show up as a recurring theme in post-launch feedback or drive avoidable rework.

title: Bilingual paralegal / legal assistant
description:
Company Description

Catalyze X is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.

Role Description

Catalyze X is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Case Intake & Opening Process all new client intake information and documentation. Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems. Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents. Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information. Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.

Case Management & Closing Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date. Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure. Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status. Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.

Document Management & Discovery Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions. Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving. Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards. Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.

Administrative & Client Support Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars. Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications. Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries. Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.

Qualifications Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America. Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written). Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail. Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment. Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and Bit Locker / Windows Device Encryption turned on Mac: Apple Mac Book / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported mac OS version with File Vault enabled Not permitted: Chromebooks (Chrome OS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)

Noise-canceling headset

Power and internet backup required

Compensation: $7 per hour

Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone

If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.

title: Research specialist
description:
Role Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for someone to join us as a Research Specialist to work in a truly global environment to join its Research & Market Intelligence team, turning first-hand field information into insights that support commercial, trading, and risk management decisions reporting jointly to GM Volcafe Brasil and Head of Research, Volcafe Global Research.

Volcafe Ltd is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We supply the world’s major coffee roasters and retail distributors with their green coffee requirements, with significant strategic growth ambitions for the future.

Volcafe works across the whole green coffee supply chain to make coffee business better, together with our partners and employees. We have built and operate sustainable coffee supply chains across all our origins, addressing key economic, social and environmental issues in coffee farming communities. Our Volcafe Way farmer support programme engages with thousands of coffee farmers and provides a holistic response to the challenges they face.

This role will be working for Volcafe Brasil , base is Santos/SP; the job is substantially on the road. This is a highly hands-on position, with approximately 40–50% of working time spent travelling across Brazil’s coffee-producing regions , conducting farm visits, crop tours, farmer interviews, surveys, and crop assessments. Possibility to also be based in Varginha/MG.

We are part of Hartree Partners, LP a leading global merchant commodities firm facilitating the flow of energy, metals, agriculture, and environmental products across the full commodity supply chain, connecting producers and consumers. Hartree was founded in 1997, is jointly owned by senior management and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, LP, and employs around 5,000 individuals worldwide.

Key Accountabilities Lead and actively participate in crop tours and crop assessments across Brazil’s main producing regions; Conduct farm visits and interviews with farmers, cooperatives, agronomists, and other key stakeholders; Develop Arabica and Conilon production estimates and supply & demand analysis; Monitor stocks, exports, logistics flows, and key coffee market developments; Assess the impact of weather, frost, drought, pests, diseases, and other production risks; Coordinate and guide field researchers and structured research programs; Produce market intelligence reports and analysis for the Trading desk and senior management; Develop dashboards, structured datasets, and automated workflows using tools such as Power BI, Python, SQL, and AI solutions.

Skills and Experience Degree in Agronomy or Agricultural Engineering; other quantitative backgrounds may be considered with strong and proven field research experience; 5+ years of experience in agricultural commodity research, market analysis, or a trading-adjacent analytical role; Recent and sustained hands-on experience with field visits, farmer surveys, and crop assessments; Experience with production forecasting, supply & demand analysis, and market intelligence; Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI and Python or SQL; Fluent Portuguese and English, both written and spoken; Availability to travel approximately 40–50% of working time.

Preferred Experience

Experience in the coffee market , Brazil crop forecasting, field team coordination, exposure to trading desks and market risk discussions, Spanish language skills, and the application of AI tools to research automation.

We are looking for someone who combines strong agronomic knowledge, active field presence, and analytical capability, transforming information from producing regions into high-quality intelligence for business and trading decisions.

We recognise that talent comes in many forms, and we value potential just as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Our Offer

We provide a fast-paced, stimulating and truly global environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the global leaders in soft commodity trading.

Our Values

Respect, Integrity, Meritocracy, Client Focus, Entrepreneurship

Volcafe shares the values of our parent company, ED&F Man Commodities. Our values define who we are. They are the fundamental beliefs that determine our actions and guide our behaviour. They influence the way we communicate and collaborate, and define the way we engage with our clients, partners, and communities.

Our Commitment

We are committed to maintaining a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender, age, religion, ethnic or national origin, marital or civil partner status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are willing to make any reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process.

To apply you must have the right to work for the provided location.

title: Operador de bioprocesso
description:
Local: Diadema/SP

Regime: CLT/ Escala / Turno: 14:00-23:48 e 23:00-07:38

Área: Biotecnologia / Produção Industrial

Descrição da Função

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar como Operador de Bioprocessos, com experiência em cultivo de microrganismos (fungos e bactérias) em biorreatores do tipo STR (Stirred Tank Reactor), com volumes entre 20 e 15.000 litros.

O profissional será responsável pela condução de processos fermentativos, garantindo desempenho, qualidade e conformidade com normas operacionais e regulatórias. Atuará diretamente na operação de biorreatores, sistemas de fermentação e etapas subsequentes de recuperação e formulação de produtos biológicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

- Operar e monitorar biorreatores, centrífugas, sistemas de filtração, homogeneização e demais equipamentos de bioprocesso.

- Preparar meios de cultura, soluções e insumos para fermentação.

- Acompanhar, controlar e registrar parâmetros de processo (p H, temperatura, oxigenação, agitação, pressão etc.).

- Executar procedimentos de assepsia, limpeza e esterilização de equipamentos e áreas.

- Seguir protocolos de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP) e normas de biossegurança.

- Apoiar testes de escala piloto e industrial, conforme demanda do setor de P& D e produção. 

- Executar inoculações, alimentações e escalonamento de culturas.

- Realizar controles em processo, ajustar condições de processo conforme comportamento do cultivo, identificar e atuar na correção de desvios

- Apoiar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva básica nos equipamentos.

Requisitos

- Curso técnico ou superior em andamento/concluído em Biotecnologia, Bioquímica,  Química, Farmácia, Alimentos ou áreas correlatas (ou cursando graduação).

title: Global sales support specialist (contractor)
description:
Role Description

The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.

This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively.

Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month Duration - 12 months

Your Impact

This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Sales Support Excellence: Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ.

Process Documentation & Best Practices: Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials.

System & Process Improvement: Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination: Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes.

Project Management & Communication: Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Prioritization & Execution: Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.

Your Experience

Experience: 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a Saa S or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies.

Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes.

Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment.

Organizational & Analytical Skills: Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements.

Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support. Language: Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Information about Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: Vice president (vp), licensing
description:
ABOUT US Welcome to Exela Bioscience.
Headquartered in Singapore, Exela Bioscience is an SME specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to elevating well-being through strategic excellence. We are driven by a philosophy that actively searches for and develops a value portfolio of innovative and orphan drugs.
Exela Bioscience specializes in key therapeutic areas that have high unmet medical needs, including Oncology, Hematology, OB-GYN, and Orphan Drugs. We focus on bridging gaps in healthcare by bringing crucial, high-value medical solutions and partner value to serve patients and the medical community across Southeast Asia, the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), and the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) regions.
At Exela, we believe that true innovation requires collaboration. Our success is rooted in our ability to forge powerful partnerships that accelerate the journey from drug discovery to patient access. We are a dynamic, fast-growing organization committed to quality, excellence, and improving life.
For more information, please visit
POSITION SUMMARY Exela Bioscience is seeking an exceptional, results-driven leader to fill the role of Vice President (VP), Licensing.
As the VP, Licensing, you will be the primary architect of our corporate growth strategy through external business development. You will hold end-to-end responsibility for our globally reaching in-licensing and out-licensing programs, with a heavy emphasis on in-licensing innovative assets, platforms, and commercial rights within our core areas of Hematology, Oncology, and specialty therapeutics for our target markets.
You will lead all aspects of the deal lifecycle: from aggressive, global asset scouting and landscape analysis to scientific evaluation, rigorous due diligence, complex financial modeling, contract negotiation, and executive-level deal execution. The ideal candidate will possess a rare combination of scientific fluency, commercial acumen, legal knowledge, and an extensive global network of industry contacts.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Strategic Leadership & Planning
Develop and execute a comprehensive, long-term licensing strategy that aligns with Exela's corporate vision, therapeutic focus, and commercial objectives in our target territories.
Identify, analyze, and prioritize therapeutic areas, technology platforms, and specific assets (pre-clinical to commercial stage) that represent high-value in-licensing opportunities.
2. Due Diligence, Evaluation, & Valuation
Lead a cross-functional Due Diligence (DD) team, coordinating input from Research & Development (R&D), Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Manufacturing (CMC), and Legal to ensure a 360-degree risk/reward assessment of every opportunity.
Synthesize findings into high-quality due diligence reports and business cases, clearly communicating investment theses and mitigating strategies to the executive leadership.
3. Negotiation & Deal Execution
Define and structure all commercial and financial terms, including upfront payments, development/regulatory milestones, commercial milestones, royalties, and profit-sharing arrangements.
Partner closely with internal and external legal counsel to manage contract drafting and negotiation, ensuring all agreements protect Exela's intellectual property, minimize liability, and comply with all applicable laws and regulations.
4. Team & Organizational Development
Build, lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global licensing team, fostering a culture of urgency, transparency, analytical rigor, and collaborative success.
Establish best-in-class processes, templates, and tools for licensing, including a robust CRM system for deal tracking and documentation.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education:
An advanced degree in biological science, biomedical engineering, pharmacy, or medicine (Master's, Ph. D. or M. D.) is strongly preferred to enable deep scientific dialogue.
A Master of Business Administration (MBA) from a top-tier business school is highly desirable.
Experience:
A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, with a minimum of 10 years dedicated to leading Licensing or Business Development roles.
A proven track record of having successfully sourced, negotiated, and closed multiple transformative licensing deals, particularly in-licensing of pre-clinical to late-stage pharmaceutical assets.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of the current biopharma licensing and deal landscape within the Hematology and Oncology fields.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Extensive experience in licensing orphan drugs or therapeutics for specialty markets.
A strong network and understanding of the pharmaceutical commercial landscape in Exela's target regions: Southeast Asia, CIS, and MENA.
Previous experience in alliance management.
WHAT WE OFFER
The opportunity to play a core role in building a globally impactful specialty pharmaceutical company.
A highly entrepreneurial, supportive, and dynamic work environment.
Competitive salary and performance-based bonus structure.
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
APPLICATION PROCESS Exela Bioscience is an equal-opportunity employer.

Liderar toda a jornada comercial, desde a geração e entrada das oportunidades até o fechamento; Estruturar estratégias para geração, qualificação e conversão de oportunidades; Definir critérios e processos de qualificação comercial; Aumentar as taxas de conversão ao longo do funil; Identificar e reduzir gargalos nas diferentes etapas da operação; Trabalhar continuamente para melhorar a produtividade e reduzir o ciclo comercial; Garantir disciplina, qualidade e utilização estratégica do CRM; Desenvolver processos, políticas e metodologias comerciais; Estruturar uma operação cada vez mais previsível, eficiente e escalável; Construir e acompanhar o forecast comercial; Criar planos de ação diante de desvios de performance. Inteligência Comercial e Expansão Territorial
Fortalecer a utilização de dados na estratégia de expansão; Analisar o potencial de mercados, cidades e regiões; Utilizar inteligência comercial e territorial na tomada de decisão; Avaliar oportunidades e capacidade de expansão em diferentes territórios; Identificar regiões com maior potencial de desenvolvimento; Cruzar informações comerciais, demográficas e mercadológicas; Apoiar decisões estratégicas com base em dados e potencial real de mercado; Integrar inteligência comercial, desenvolvimento territorial e oportunidades de expansão. Gestão de Performance e Indicadores
Implantar e fortalecer uma cultura comercial de alta performance; Definir metas, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento; Monitorar performance individual, coletiva, territorial e por canal; Acompanhar a evolução do pipeline e das taxas de conversão; Analisar produtividade, ciclo comercial e previsibilidade de resultados; Identificar causas de desvios e oportunidades de melhoria; Transformar dados e indicadores em decisões e planos de ação práticos; Garantir acompanhamento consistente dos resultados da área e evolução contínua da operação. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas
Liderar e desenvolver uma estrutura comercial multidisciplinar; Desenvolver líderes e executivos comerciais; Estabelecer metas e expectativas claras; Acompanhar performance individual e coletiva; Realizar feedbacks consistentes e conversas de desenvolvimento; Reconhecer e fortalecer comportamentos de alta performance; Atuar de forma estruturada diante de baixa performance; Identificar talentos e construir planos de desenvolvimento; Fortalecer autonomia, responsabilidade e colaboração; Mobilizar a equipe em torno dos objetivos estratégicos da companhia; Construir uma liderança presente, próxima, exigente e capaz de engajar pessoas. Negociação e Relacionamento Estratégico
Participar de negociações comerciais estratégicas e de maior complexidade; Construir relacionamento com potenciais parceiros, investidores e oportunidades relevantes para o negócio; Apoiar negociações que envolvam expansão, desenvolvimento de novos mercados e oportunidades estratégicas; Representar institucionalmente a estratégia comercial quando necessário; Desenvolver e manter networking relevante dentro dos ecossistemas de franquias, varejo e negócios; Conduzir negociações com alto nível de influência, argumentação e visão de longo prazo. Integração com Outras Áreas
Trabalhar de forma integrada com Marketing, garantindo alinhamento entre campanhas, geração de demanda, aquisição e qualidade das oportunidades; Atuar em parceria com as áreas responsáveis pela implantação e operação das novas unidades; Avaliar a sustentabilidade e viabilidade da expansão junto às áreas envolvidas; Trabalhar com o Financeiro na construção de projeções, acompanhamento de resultados e viabilidade de iniciativas; Interagir com o Jurídico em temas relacionados aos processos e negociações comerciais; Considerar aspectos logísticos e operacionais na definição de novas estratégias de expansão; Garantir uma visão integrada de que a comercialização representa o início de uma relação de longo prazo entre a companhia e seus parceiros. INDICADORES
Será responsável por acompanhar, interpretar e transformar dados em ações, considerando indicadores como: Crescimento e expansão da rede; Atingimento das metas comerciais; Volume e qualidade das oportunidades; Conversão por etapa do funil; Performance individual e coletiva; Produtividade comercial; Receita e resultados gerados pela área; Tempo médio do ciclo comercial; Eficiência e previsibilidade do pipeline; Forecast comercial; Performance por canal e território; Evolução em mercados estratégicos; Desenvolvimento das lideranças e equipes; Cumprimento do planejamento e dos objetivos estratégicos. PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS
Procuramos um(a) executivo(a)
extremamente comunicativo(a), estratégico(a), relacional, influente e orientado(a) a resultados , capaz de transitar com segurança entre a construção da estratégia, a análise de dados, o desenvolvimento de pessoas e a execução comercial. Essa pessoa precisa combinar
energia comercial + comunicação + liderança + estratégia + dados + execução. Buscamos alguém com maturidade executiva e forte presença, que consiga gerar conexão rapidamente, mobilizar equipes, defender ideias, conduzir negociações complexas e transformar desafios de crescimento em planos claros e resultados concretos. liderança comercial e desenvolvimento de negócios ; Experiência relevante com
expansão de franquias, grandes redes, varejo ou food service ; Histórico de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes comerciais de alta performance; Experiência na gestão de estruturas comerciais relevantes e multidisciplinares; Domínio de planejamento comercial, pipeline, CRM e forecast; Forte experiência com gestão de indicadores e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Vivência com metas desafiadoras e ambientes de crescimento acelerado; Experiência em negociação estratégica e vendas consultivas; Capacidade de estruturar ou transformar operações comerciais; Experiência com expansão territorial e inteligência comercial será um diferencial importante; Conhecimento em geomarketing e análise de potencial de mercado será considerado um diferencial; Experiência em organizações que tenham passado por ciclos relevantes de escala e expansão será altamente valorizada; Ensino Superior completo em áreas relacionadas a Negócios, Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial. O que será mais importante para nós!
Liderança:
capacidade comprovada de desenvolver, mobilizar e elevar a performance de equipes e lideranças. Comunicação e influência:
excelente capacidade de relacionamento, articulação, persuasão e presença executiva. Expansão:
experiência real em crescimento de negócios, preferencialmente em redes, franquias, varejo ou ambientes de expansão acelerada. Gestão e dados:
domínio de pipeline, CRM, forecast, indicadores e inteligência comercial para tomada de decisão. Visão estratégica:
capacidade de conectar mercado, oportunidades, pessoas e objetivos de negócio. Execução:
habilidade para transformar estratégias em prioridades, processos, planos de ação e resultados concretos. Resultados:
histórico consistente de crescimento, conversão, expansão e atingimento de metas. Importante: é necessário ter disponibilidade para
residir e atuar presencialmente em Goiânia/GO. Se você é um(a) executivo(a) comercial com forte visão de negócios, paixão por crescimento e capacidade de construir, liderar e escalar operações de alta performance, queremos conhecer você!

description:

title: Cfo as a service (b2b saas)
description:
SOBRE A VAGA Buscamos um(a) CFO as a Service / Fractional CFO com forte experiência em B2 B Saa S para atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) do CEO, C-Level e Head de Finance. Nossa estrutura de Finance já conduz as principais rotinas financeiras, contábeis, fiscais, de caixa e controles, sob liderança da Head de Finance. A posição reporta ao CEO e não tem relação hierárquica com essa liderança, o foco aqui é agregar experiência e repertório em Strategic Finance, Saa S Metrics, FP&A, Unit Economics e Performance Management.
Suas principais responsabilidades:
Atuar como sparring partner do CEO, C-Level e Head de Finance em decisões de investimento, crescimento, eficiência e alocação de recursos.
Apoiar a evolução do uso de métricas de B2 B Saa S, como ARR/MRR, churn, GRR/NRR, CAC, CAC Payback, LTV/CAC ratio, Gross Margin, Magic Number, Cohort Analysis e demais métricas relevantes para negócios Saa S.
Aprimorar processos de budget, forecast e planejamento financeiro, incluindo análises de cenários e sensibilidades.
Estruturar business cases para novos produtos, projetos, contratações e investimentos.
Aprofundar análises de performance e eficiência, conectando resultados financeiros a recomendações práticas para o negócio.
Trazer benchmarks e referências de mercado que apoiem decisões sobre crescimento, rentabilidade, geração de caixa e eficiência.
Atuar como parceiro(a) e mentor(a) da Head de Finance, compartilhando repertório, frameworks e experiências práticas, com foco no desenvolvimento de competências de CFO e na ampliação de sua atuação em Strategic Finance, FP&A, performance e tomada de decisão executiva.
Em períodos específicos de maior necessidade, aumentar temporariamente a dedicação para apoiar a continuidade dos processos de budget, forecast e decisões financeiras relevantes.
Apoiar a construção e evolução da estratégia financeira de médio e longo prazo da companhia, conectando crescimento, rentabilidade, geração de caixa e necessidades de investimento.
Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:
Experiência relevante em posições seniores de Finance/CFO, com atuação estratégica em empresas B2 B Saa S.
Domínio de Saa S Metrics, Unit Economics, FP&A e Performance Management.
Experiência em budget, forecast, planejamento financeiro e construção de cenários.
Histórico de transformar números e análises financeiras em recomendações de negócio.
Vivência apoiando decisões de crescimento, investimento e alocação de recursos.
Capacidade de questionar premissas e desafiar decisões de forma construtiva.
Perfil estratégico, analítico e pragmático.
Perfil de mentor(a) por natureza, com histórico comprovado de desenvolver lideranças financeiras, não apenas disposição em compartilhar conhecimento, mas experiência prática em elevar a maturidade de times de Finance em Strategic Finance e FP&A.
Perfil mais voltado a Strategic Finance do que a contabilidade, fiscal ou controladoria, essas frentes já estão bem cobertas internamente.
Será um diferencial:
Experiência em Saa S em estágio de escala semelhante ou superior ao nosso.
Vivência em startups ou scale-ups de alto crescimento.
Experiência em diferentes estágios de maturidade de empresas Saa S.
Experiência em ambientes com investidores institucionais e estruturas profissionais de governança.
Modalidade de Trabalho Engajamento part-time / fractional, com dedicação inicial estimada em aproximadamente 2 dias por semana, podendo chegar temporariamente a 3 dias por semana em períodos específicos de maior necessidade. Modelo híbrido, com presença no escritório em Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, conforme agenda combinada.

title: Head de operações
description:

Liderar e desenvolver a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito de operações financeiras agrícolas, assegurando excelência na execução, segurança jurídica, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e geração de resultados. Atuará como principal elo entre Operações, Jurídico, Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio, transformando desafios operacionais em processos, controles, automações e soluções tecnológicas. Buscamos uma liderança com forte capacidade de execução, profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para construir uma operação escalável por meio de dados, tecnologia, inteligência artificial e melhoria contínua. Requisitos Desejáveis
Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio; Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito; Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas; Familiaridade com CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais; Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados; Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança; Vivência com Legal Ops, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras; Pós-graduação em Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas. title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Coordenador de manutenção mecânica
description:
Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

Responsável por coordenar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, assegurando a continuidade, segurança e eficiência das operações. Programar, distribuir e coordenar tarefas conforme necessidades e prioridades. Elaborar orçamentos e viabilizar a execução dos serviços. Avaliar relatórios de manutenção (ocorrências, OS, custos, prioridades). Definir com Compras a aquisição de equipamentos, ferramentas e materiais. Analisar e recomendar melhorias, substituições ou ampliações de equipamentos e instalações. Supervisionar e orientar terceiros em projetos e modificações. Fiscalizar serviços de empreiteiros e contratadas, garantindo qualidade e prazos. Elaborar relatórios de desempenho da manutenção via sistemas informatizados. Aplicar políticas de RH, apoiando decisões de movimentação de pessoal (admissão, promoção, transferência e desligamento). Promover a melhoria contínua das estratégias de manutenção, utilizando conceitos de confiabilidade e análise de falhas para aumentar a disponibilidade e o desempenho dos ativos. Monitorar e analisar indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog, aderência ao planejamento e custos), propondo ações para redução de falhas recorrentes e otimização dos recursos. Participar da definição da criticidade dos ativos e da revisão dos planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, priorizando riscos operacionais, segurança e continuidade do negócio. Garantir a máxima disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos da planta por meio da gestão eficiente da manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, reduzindo falhas não programadas e aumentando a eficiência operacional.

title: Procurement reconciliation & invoice validation analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Procurement Reconciliation & Invoice Validation Analyst to support the procurement process, with a focus on supplier account reconciliation, invoice checking, delivery document verification, payment request follow-up, and issue resolution.

This role will work closely with the Procurement team, suppliers, Finance, and internal business departments to ensure that supplier invoices, delivery documents, and payment-related information are accurate, complete, and properly verified before further processing.

Please note that this is not a buyer or purchasing negotiation role . The position is mainly focused on procurement-related reconciliation, invoice validation, supplier document checking, and internal coordination.

Key Responsibilities Responsible for supplier account reconciliation related to procurement activities, ensuring that reconciliation tasks are completed accurately and on time; Check and validate supplier invoices against delivery notes, purchase-related documents, and internal records; Review invoice information and identify issues such as incorrect amounts, quantities, supplier information, tax information, missing documents, or other discrepancies; Submit, follow up, and verify payment requests related to procurement activities, ensuring that all required supporting documents are complete and accurate; Communicate with suppliers and guide them on the correct issuance of invoices according to company requirements; Coordinate with the Finance team for supplier balance confirmation letters and assist in the follow-up of supplier account confirmations and replies; Support the follow-up and cleanup of long-aged outstanding supplier balances and unresolved procurement-related payment issues; Work with Procurement, Finance, and internal departments to resolve invoice, delivery note, reconciliation, and payment-related exceptions; Maintain organized records and documentation to ensure traceability and support internal review or audit requirements.

Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, or related fields; Experience in procurement support, supplier reconciliation, invoice validation, accounts payable support, receiving/fiscal document checking, or related administrative/financial processes; Familiarity with invoices, purchase-related documents, delivery notes, supplier statements, and payment request processes; Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies in documents and data; Good communication skills and ability to work with suppliers and cross-functional teams; Good execution capability, sense of responsibility, organization skills, and ability to work under pressure; Proficient in daily office software, especially Excel; Willing to work in a Chinese multinational company and adapt to a multicultural working environment; Available to work on-site in Camaçari, Bahia.

Language Requirements English communication ability is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required for local supplier and internal communication; Mandarin Chinese is a plus, but not mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or multinational companies; Experience working with suppliers, invoices, purchase orders, delivery notes, and payment-related documents; Experience with SAP, ERP, SRM, or other procurement/finance systems; Previous experience supporting Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, or Supply Chain teams.

Role Scope Clarification

This position is focused on supplier reconciliation, invoice validation, payment request checking, and procurement process support . It does not mainly involve supplier price negotiation, purchasing decision-making, PO issuance, category management, or payment execution.

Apoiar o time de marketing em demandas gerais de conteúdo e cobertura de eventos internos.
